const f=s=>{const p=s.split(';'),u=/^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/,v=x=>{const q=x.split('.');return q.length===3&&q.every(z=>u.test(z)&&Number(z)<=1000000)?q.map(Number):null},cmp=(a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]||a[1]-b[1]||a[2]-b[2];if(p.length!==2||!p[1])return null;const c=v(p[0]),seen=new Set;let best=null;if(!c)return null;for(const x of p[1].split(',')){const q=v(x),id=q&&q.join('.');if(!q||seen.has(id))return null;seen.add(id);if(cmp(q,c)<=0&&(!best||cmp(q,best)>0))best=q}return best?best.join('.'):''};
